story_note: Phil returns to the morning puzzle with calm determination, noticing subtle changes in today's clues that require his steady, careful logic.
continuation_note: Having unlocked a key column and made steady progress, Phil looks forward to a return visit tomorrow to continue exploring new challenges in the Sapiver Press Suite.

scenes.title: Back Again
scenes.beat: Return after yesterday, new daily puzzle, same habit
scenes.caption: Phil readies his tea and puzzle.

scenes.title: Different Start
scenes.beat: The first move shows today's puzzle is different
scenes.dialogue: Hmm, that clue twists in an unexpected way.
scenes.caption: Early signs of today’s unique challenge.

scenes.title: The Pushback
scenes.beat: A fair stuck moment, no guessing
scenes.dialogue: No guesses yet; I need a clear head.
scenes.caption: Phil pauses, thinking deeply.

scenes.title: The Column
scenes.dialogue: That column’s logic just snapped into place!
scenes.caption: A breakthrough sharpens his progress.

scenes.title: The Follow-Through
scenes.dialogue: Now the grid is unfolding neatly.
scenes.caption: Answers slot in with steady clarity.

scenes.title: Worth Returning For
scenes.beat: Completion or honest latest progress, return tomorrow
scenes.dialogue: Almost finished—I'll pick this up tomorrow.
scenes.caption: Steady progress ensures a return visit.

style_rules: No masthead inside individual scene art.
Sapiver Press logo/title only on merchandise and monitor/browser URL.
Story text must continue from previous episode, not repeat a fixed template.
Puzzle screen must be composited from real capture, not invented by image generation.
The scene should be comic illustration, not photorealism.
